
{{alias}}( order, side, pivot, direct, M, N, C, S, A, LDA )
    Applies a sequence of plane rotations to a general rectangular matrix `A`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string
        Storage layout. Must be either 'row-major' or 'column-major'.

    side: string
        Specifies the side where plane rotation matrix `P` is applied to `A`.

    pivot: string
        Specifies the plane for which `P(k)` is a plane rotation matrix.

    direct: string
        Specifies whether `P` is a forward or backward sequence of plane
        rotations.

    M: integer
        Number of rows in `A`.

    N: integer
        Number of columns in `A`.

    C: Float64Array
        Array of cosines of the plane rotations.

    S: Float64Array
        Array of sines of the plane rotations.

    A: Float64Array
        Input/output matrix.

    LDA: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `A` (a.k.a., leading dimension
        of the matrix `A`).

    Returns
    -------
    A: Float64Array
        Output matrix.

    Examples
    --------
    > var C = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.8, 0.7, 0.9 ] );
    > var S = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.6, -0.7142, 0.4358 ] );
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}([ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ]);
    > {{alias}}('column-major', 'left', 'variable', 'forward', 3, 2, C, S, A, 3)
    <Float64Array>[ 2.0, ~-1.443, ~2.814, 6.2, ~-3.165, ~5.343 ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( side,pivot,direct,M,N,C,sC,oC,S,sS,oS,A,sA1,sA2,oA )
    Applies a sequence of plane rotations to a general rectangular matrix `A`
    using alternative indexing semantics.

    Parameters
    ----------
    side: string
        Specifies the side where plane rotation matrix `P` is applied to `A`.

    pivot: string
        Specifies the plane for which `P(k)` is a plane rotation matrix.

    direct: string
        Specifies whether `P` is a forward or backward sequence of plane
        rotations.

    M: integer
        Number of rows in `A`.

    N: integer
        Number of columns in `A`.

    C: Float64Array
        Array of cosines of the plane rotations.

    sC: integer
        Stride length for `C`.

    oC: integer
        Starting index for `C`.

    S: Float64Array
        Array of sines of the plane rotations.

    sS: integer
        Stride length for `S`.

    oS: integer
        Starting index for `S`.

    A: Float64Array
        Input/output matrix.

    sA1: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `A`.

    sA2: integer
        Stride of the second dimension of `A`.

    oA: integer
        Starting index for `A`.

    Returns
    -------
    A: Float64Array
        Output matrix.

    Examples
    --------
    > var C = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.8, 0.7, 0.9 ] );
    > var S = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.6, -0.7142, 0.4358 ] );
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}([ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ]);
    > {{alias}}.ndarray('left','variable','forward',3,2,C,1,0,S,1,0,A,1,3,0)
    <Float64Array>[ 2.0, ~-1.443, ~2.814, 6.2, ~-3.165, ~5.343 ]

    See Also
    --------
